1.w: As for you, the one who lives in the shelter of the Most High, and resides in the protective shadow of the Sovereign One —

2.w: I say this about the Lord, my shelter and my stronghold, my God in whom I trust—

3.w: he will certainly rescue you from the snare of the hunter and from the destructive plague.

4.w: He will shelter you with his wings; you will find safety under his wings. His faithfulness is like a shield or a protective wall.

5.w: You need not fear the terrors of the night, the arrow that flies by day,

6.w: the plague that stalks in the darkness, or the disease that ravages at noon.

7.w: Though a thousand may fall beside you, and a multitude on your right side, it will not reach you.

8.w: Certainly you will see it with your very own eyes— you will see the wicked paid back.

9.w: For you have taken refuge in the Lord, my shelter, the Most High.

10.w: No harm will overtake you; no illness will come near your home.

11.w: For he will order his angels to protect you in all you do.

12.w: They will lift you up in their hands, so you will not slip and fall on a stone.

13.w: You will subdue a lion and a snake; you will trample underfoot a young lion and a serpent.

14.w: The Lord says, “Because he is devoted to me, I will deliver him; I will protect him because he is loyal to me.

15.w: When he calls out to me, I will answer him. I will be with him when he is in trouble; I will rescue him and bring him honor.

16.w: I will satisfy him with long life and will let him see my salvation.”
